sections.Context: The paper targets long-horizon manipulation from source-grounded evidence.
sections.Related Work: It compares diffusion policies against prior imitation baselines.
sections.Gap: Existing long-horizon systems degrade under partial observability.
sections.Proposal: Use a source-grounded diffusion policy with task-conditioned planning.
sections.Key Results: The replay policy improves success rates while keeping the controller simple.
sections.Discussion: The result looks promising but remains limited to tabletop manipulation.
sections.Next Steps: Verify how the approach behaves on real robots.
